profile_text.body:
Runway is a for-profit startup founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, NY. On its own site the company describes itself as building foundational Real-World Intelligence that can understand, simulate and act in the world, with products and services built on top of that intelligence to help individuals and organizations do more. It says it works with customers to fit its surfaces to their hardware.

The company's stated AI work centers on GWM-1, which it describes as a state-of-the-art General World Model and a step toward universal simulation, and which it says powers components including policy inference and evaluation and synthetic data generation. It also describes Solaris as its first Interface World Model, real-time AI that generates interactive interfaces frame by frame with no code, and it publishes material on enterprise video generation covering themes such as data sovereignty, cost economics, autonomous execution and model ownership. Its tracked product is Runway, listed under video generation and editing.

The company's legal record includes five cases: David Vance Gardner v. Runway AI, Inc. and Businessing LLC v. Runway AI, Inc., both in the District Court for the Southern District of New York; a second David Vance Gardner v. Runway AI, Inc. in the Central District of California; Ace Cam, Inc. v. Runway AI Inc in the Southern District of New York; and Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd. in the Northern District of California. New York is recorded as a jurisdiction of law exposure, with 459 cases. No MCP server is listed for the company.
